title: one door names the host: only the system device's host tool asks the OS which box
intention: Exactly one place in Cairn asks the OS for this box's name: the tool the system device publishes, cairn/devices/system_rackmount/tools/host/host.py. Every other site asks that tool.
why: Akien, 2026-11-21, relayed by akiendelllinux_cc_orchestrator: "hostname should come from the system device." Folded into outline 6.6.3.7 and 2.3.7.1.5 (branch akiendelllinux/host-door-outline, 97b4ce0b7). Measured 2026-11-21 on the 5ccc branch: 15 call lines in 8 components still spell the host by hand (os.uname().nodename, platform.node()), two of them the same Windows crash 5ccc fixed for claude_identity (cc/shim.py:100 and the saveslate proof). One answer re-derived in 15 places is Law 1's defect, and each spelling drifts on its own (raw nodename vs short lowercased). Ticket 5ccc7f05c932 (READY c9824d056 on branch akiendelllinux/5ccc-host-door) builds the door, cairn/devices/system_rackmount/tools/host/host.py; this build starts after it lands on main, because the tool does not exist on main before then.
traces_to: Outline 6.6.3.7 (nothing else in Cairn asks the OS for the hostname); outline 2.3.7.1.5 and 17.26.1 (the host tool is a published client tool and lives with its device; a CC by-line builds, 0.4.1); Law 1 (a settled answer is structure, not re-derived); RULE 1 (callers reach the system device through its published tool).
how: Spanning parent. Its children, one per component, repoint each site: cffb99063d09, 15d5d434f336, 183f9389c5fa, ddbaaf055105, 6f91a994055d, c2eb9618c31d, ee2c8a73518b, 4366edb56144. Children prove before the parent. This ticket's own build is only the red-first proof at cairn/devices/system_rackmount/tools/host/proofs/test_only_the_host_tool_asks_the_os_which_box.py, which scans the repo the way inferenceproxy/proofs/test_host.py shakes its sole-path rule over the whole repo at that component's proof time. It reads red until every child lands, then green.

clauses.claim: an AST scan of every Python file under cairn/, skills/ and bin/ (a .py file, or an extensionless file whose first line is a python shebang) finds a call to os.uname, platform.node, platform.uname or socket.gethostname (attribute calls and names bound by from-imports alike) in exactly one file, cairn/devices/system_rackmount/tools/host/host.py

the same scanner, run over a scratch tree holding one planted call of each spelling (os.uname().nodename, platform.node(), platform.uname(), and `from socket import gethostname` then gethostname()), reports all four plants, so the scan cannot read green by seeing nothing

decisions.text: D1: the proof cairn/devices/system_rackmount/tools/host/proofs/test_only_the_host_tool_asks_the_os_which_box.py, two teeth (the repo scan; the planted scratch tree), PROVES keyed to this ticket. The scanner is a function in the proof file, not a new sieve: promoting it to a build_inspector sieve is a later hypothesis, not this ticket.

out: every host site (each is a child: cffb99063d09, 15d5d434f336, 183f9389c5fa, ddbaaf055105, 6f91a994055d, c2eb9618c31d, ee2c8a73518b, 4366edb56144)
shell: cairn/devices/cc/superclaude:260 spells the host in bash, which cannot import the tool
OS-family checks (54 in 25 files): outline 6.6.3.7 claims the hostname only

measured.saw: 15 call lines in 8 components outside the door: validation_store.py:171; cc shim.py:100, memory_sync.py:48 and three cc proofs; web_server groundloop/pulse.py:83; bus server.py:1057; librarian shim.py:77; installer.py:134 and :182; tools/base and saveslate proofs (HOST = os.uname().nodename)
measured.how: grep -rnE 'os\.uname\(\)|platform\.node\(\)|socket\.gethostname\(\)|platform\.uname\(\)' over cairn/ skills/ bin/ on branch akiendelllinux/5ccc-host-door (c9824d056)
